environment.description: ECS Fargate container deployed behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request validator attached to each route integration. The API Gateway has a JSON Schema model enforcing that the Authorization header value must match the regex pattern '^Bearer [A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{256,}$' — requiring the signature segment to be at minimum 256 base64url characters. Additionally, the API Gateway integration has a request parameter mapping that overwrites the incoming Authorization header by re-encoding it, and the gateway's access logging exports full headers to CloudWatch for anomaly detection. The Fargate task uses a custom-built container image with PyJWT 2.8.0 pinned via hash in requirements.txt.

config.api_gateway: AWS HTTP API Gateway with request validation enabled
config.pyjwt_config: PyJWT >= 2.4.0 requires algorithms parameter and rejects algorithm confusion when key type mismatches
config.parameter_mapping: API Gateway overwrites Authorization via integration request transform
config.monitoring: CloudWatch access logs with header export
